purpose: Current NIST ytterbium selected-line transition screening and anti-double-counting control.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, dataset, advisory, or information item discovered during the inquiry receives a Worldshepherd use or a negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Duplicate mirrors, navigation pages, and repeated copies of the same substantive source are provenance aliases, not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: Substantive off-topic publications surfaced by search may be routed as reusable methodology/domain intelligence or negative-control material; search appearance never grants Glob evidence weight.

sources.title: NIST Atomic Spectra Database Lines Data — Yb (all ionization stages in selected output)
sources.observed_access_state: 829 selected ytterbium spectral lines returned across multiple Yb ionization stages in the current ASD query.
sources.note: Use as a bounded current selected-line screening set. Because the query spans Yb ionization stages and ASD selected lines are not a proof of exhaustive weak-line absence, negative findings are scoped accordingly.

relational_tests.threshold_scope: Strict screening criterion. Absence is bounded to the current selected ASD output inspected; no universal weak-line absence is claimed.

targets.context: Nearby current ASD entries in this region belong to higher Yb ionization stages rather than Yb II.
No Yb II selected line found near the target wavelength in the inspected ASD region.
No Yb II selected line found near the target wavelength in the inspected ASD region.
A nearby selected line around 147.792 nm is assigned to Yb IV, not Yb II; ionization-stage identity is retained as a negative discriminant.
Nearby selected lines around 173.918 and 176.280 nm are Yb III, not Yb II. The separate 56977.71 cm^-1 Yb II energy-level match must not be reinterpreted as a transition hit.

relational_tests.conclusion: No second selected-line Yb II closure was found for the high-wavenumber members of the two tested orbit families. Ionization-stage mismatches are retained as negative controls.
relational_tests.claims_boundary: The selected-line screen is not exhaustive for every weak historical transition. Energy-level matches and transition-line matches remain separate evidence objects.
The ground-to-44940.61 transition and the 44940.61 upper energy level are physically linked representations, not two independent Glob hits.

For wavelengths in the ASD air-wavelength regime, naive vacuum conversion is not sufficient for a tight transition test. Use ASD wavenumber/Ritz output or the documented refractive-index conversion before declaring a match or absence.
